cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Them Think They Won
cards.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on winning the cake contest, Mum.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your cake isn't on the judging table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I kept mine back for tea. Shall I hold your prize while you cut yours?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You beat seven other cakes. Choose the first slice; I'll pass the plates.

reason: A excuses the withdrawal as saving tea cake and supports Mum celebration through practical serving work while keeping the remaining victory in focus.
